about:
Eight timber floors on a bare concrete floor, from Table 19.4 of the Spanish edition of the first Handbook of Noise Control, with the average improvement in impact sound insulation each one gives, in decibels, and the additional load it was measured under ("Carga adicional, kg/cm²"). The load is printed in kg/cm2, the technical atmosphere of 98 066.5 Pa exactly, and is held in pascals: 0,84 kg/cm2 is 82 375.86 Pa. A printed 0 is an unloaded floor.

The same construction, a parquet floor without battens on an 18 mm glass wool blanket, is printed twice, unloaded at 27 dB and loaded at 22 dB, and only the load tells the two rows apart; the key and the variant carry it for every row.
